Q5731.reason: The brother's interest is contingent because it depends on an uncertain future event (the uncle moving), and since the preceding life estate has not ended yet, it cannot be a remainder pur autre vie.

Q5115.reason: Lactate production increases as muscle pH falls due to the accumulation of hydrogen ions during anaerobic glycolysis.

Q5932.reason: Prolonged intermittent high-intensity exercise often depletes glycogen stores and can cause blood glucose to fall into hypoglycaemic levels.
